name: mcp-news-briefing
description: Personalized news briefing + stock watchlist — curated news from RSS, Reddit, and Hacker News based on your interests, plus per-stock sentiment analysis (bullish/bearish) with customizable focus areas. Supports US and ASX markets.

tools.description: Register and get a token for personalized briefings
